title.en: Theory of Becoming — the aim, as the direction page tells it
title.zh: 生成／变化之论——目标，如方向页所述

scope.en: The aim of the continuing work on the Theory of Becoming, adjusted on 20 November 2026 toward the direction of 14 to 20 November and its map, after Ren's words of that day: one map of how things come to be, go on, change and end. The direction page (`_process/DIRECTION.md`) is where the aim is told and changed; this record points to it. The wording of this record's title, scope, objective and overview is AI-written. Ren was shown the objective in English on 20 November 2026 and answered, by a reply button labelled "Yes, land it", that it be landed; the rest he has not read. Completed results and the scopes of independently authorized tasks are kept. The wording before this change, written from his words of 8 October and changed until 11 November, is in this file's history in git (as it stood at commit `70f4829b3`).
scope.zh: 生成／变化之论持续工作的目标，于2026年11月20日在 Ren 当日的话之后，向11月14日至20日的方向及其地图调整：一张地图，画的是事物如何出现、持续、变化与终结。目标在方向页（`_process/DIRECTION.md`）上陈述并修改；本记录指向它。本记录的标题、范围、目标与概述的措辞为 AI 所写。2026年11月20日，Ren 看过目标的英文措辞，并按下标为“Yes, land it”的回复按钮，答复将其落地；其余部分他尚未读过。已完成的成果与各独立授权任务的范围保留。此次修改之前的措辞，据他10月8日的话写成并改到11月11日，见本文件的 git 历史（提交 `70f4829b3` 时的样子）。

objective.en: One map of how things come to be, go on, change and end, whole enough that a person, a society or an AI can find its own course on it, joined and simple, its core proved in Lean, each piece holding under its stated conditions. What is wanted on it, how far we are from it, and what is tried next are told on the direction page under "Where we are heading" and "What we are trying next". The map is drawn from inside what it maps: that an actual situation meets a theorem's premises, no proof gives (`AGENTS.md`, rule 2). It can become the next single measure; what can prevent that is that a case, a failed test or a reader who disagrees can still turn it. October's objective, as this record worded it until 20 November 2026, is adjusted to this. What was reached under it is kept as results, and its open items stay on their records and rows.
objective.zh: 一张地图，画的是事物如何出现、持续、变化与终结，完整到一个人、一个社会或一个 AI 能在上面找到自己所走的路；各部分相接而简明；其核心在 Lean 中证明，每一条都在各自写明的条件下成立。地图上想要什么、我们离它还有多远、下一步试什么，见方向页“Where we are heading”与“What we are trying next”两节。这张地图是从它所画的东西之内画出来的：一个实际情形是否满足某条定理的前提，没有证明能给出（`AGENTS.md` 第二条）。它可能变成下一个单一的尺度；能防止这一点的，是一个案例、一次失败的检验或一位不同意的读者仍能使它转向。本记录在2026年11月20日之前所写的十月目标，调整为此。在它之下取得的成果仍作为成果保留；其未决事项留在各自的记录与工作板的行上。

premises.en: What follows was written for October's objective and is kept as written; it has not been set against the direction page. Begin with the monist relational method and disclose its role. Retain mixed effects, real losses and terminal continuations. Distinguish logical machinery, definitions, local laws, correspondence and normative commitments; a supplied local law is not thereby external to reality. The theory asserts no axiom: everything that holds for any significance is stated without one, living significance is characterized and shown undecided by the dynamics, and the continuation condition (for anything, its continuation into the future has significance) enters only as a named hypothesis (chapter 7 §3, §4.5), under which living significance is a theorem. How two courses differ is read on possibilities: on level paths one course widens another where at every step it admits every formation the other admits, and at some step one more, a relation between two courses within becoming, not good and evil. The generative space is stated with no axiom: a part is generative where the levels with it widen those without it. Under the continuation condition, widening is retaining and adding what has significance from each standpoint; on the own-closure reading, what lies within one's own reach (chapter 7 §2, §4.4). The practical commitments of the alignment route stay explicit within the whole, without becoming premises of every dynamical explanation.
premises.zh: 以下为十月的目标而写，照原样保留，尚未与方向页对照。 从一元关系方法出发并公开其作用。保留混合效果、真实损失与终结的延续。区分逻辑工具、定义、局部规律、对应与规范承诺；给定的局部规律并不因此外在于实在。理论不断言任何公理：凡对任何意义成立者都无需公理陈述；生命的意义得到刻画，且动力学不决定它；延续条件（任何东西向未来的延续都有意义）只作为一个具名的假设出现（第七章 §3、§4.5），在此条件下生命的意义是定理。两条进程如何不同，按可能性来读：在水平路径上，一条进程扩大另一条，是指它在每一步都容纳另一条所容纳的每一个形成，并在某一步多容纳一个；这是生灭变化之中两条进程之间的一种关系，不是善与恶。生成空间无需公理陈述：一个部分在“有它”的层级扩大了“无它”的层级之处是生成的。在延续条件下，扩大即从每一立场保留并增加有意义者；在自闭包读法之下，即保留并增加自身所能到达者（第七章 §2、§4.4）。对齐路线的实践承诺在整体之内保持明示，不成为每个动力学解释的前提。

completion.en: This record gives no criterion of completion for the adjusted aim. What follows was written for October's objective and is kept as written; the criterion K1–K7 still runs, as a check on that earlier target. Reuse completed conditional mechanisms and identify the exact remaining foundational inference. Assess zero normative axioms and zero added substantive axioms separately; neither outcome inclusion, an empty Lean axiom report nor hidden hypotheses establishes the stronger target. Explain actual possibilities and constraints, expose remaining dependencies, and preserve substantive counterexamples. This priority authorization does not certify a new result or universal completion. Establish the whole claim at its stated scope; do not substitute universal generativity for the whole or treat a mode’s absence as its refutation. Completeness is checked by the completion criterion K1–K7 (coverage, unity, premises, representation, enclosure, the ethics chain, the open register; study section 218), adopted 20 October 2026 with Ren's approval; it runs (tools/research/completion.py, report theories/becoming/results/completion/COMPLETION.md, R39), and while a criterion is unmet the chapter claims completeness only in the qualified sense it states.
completion.zh: 本记录不为调整后的目标给出完成标准。以下为十月的目标而写，照原样保留；完成标准 K1–K7 仍在运行，作为对那个早先目标的检查。 复用已完成条件机制，指出尚缺的确切基础推论。分别检验无规范公理与无附加实质公理；包容全部结果、空 Lean 公理报告或隐藏假设都不等于更强目标成立。说明实际可能与限制，公开剩余依赖并保留实质反例。本优先授权不认证新成果或普遍完成。 按所声明范围建立整体主张；不以普遍生成性替换整体，不把某种形态缺失直接视为整体反例。 完整性由完成标准 K1–K7 检查（覆盖、统一、前提、表示、封闭、伦理之链、开放登记；研究第 218 节），2026年10月20日经 Ren 批准采用；它已运行（tools/research/completion.py，报告 theories/becoming/results/completion/COMPLETION.md，R39）；只要有一项未满足，正文只在其所述的限定意义上声称完整。

title.en: The aim: one map, as the direction page tells it
title.zh: 目标：一张地图，如方向页所述

summary.en: One map of how things come to be, go on, change and end, whole enough to find one's own course on, joined and simple, its core proved in Lean, each piece holding under its stated conditions, and drawn from inside what it maps. The direction page (`_process/DIRECTION.md`) tells the aim, how far we are from it, and what has been found.
summary.zh: 一张地图，画的是事物如何出现、持续、变化与终结，完整到能在上面找到自己所走的路；各部分相接而简明；其核心在 Lean 中证明，每一条都在各自写明的条件下成立；它是从它所画的东西之内画出来的。方向页（`_process/DIRECTION.md`）陈述目标、我们离它还有多远、已经发现了什么。

next_step.en: Told on the direction page under "What we are trying next" and in row DJ of the work board (`_process/BECOMING-WORKBOARD.md`).
next_step.zh: 见方向页“What we are trying next”一节与工作板（`_process/BECOMING-WORKBOARD.md`）的 DJ 行。
